packages/styles/README.md > states: On `<html>` the hook sets the compact scale on the body instead, so the root font size never changes and every `rem` token keeps its value (`--ocelle-target-min` stays 44 px)

packages/styles/README.md > states: `data-ocelle-density="regular"` returns a region nested in a compact one to the regular scale: `--ocelle-font-size-md` (16 px) with `--ocelle-line-height-normal` (1.45)
